description: Normalized calculator inputs for the golden set: the 'extraction answer key'. Values are taken from data/golden_set/<case_id>.json. Units: LDL-C and non-HDL-C in mmol/L, apoB and Lp(a) in mg/dL. Changes are placebo-adjusted; negative = reduction.

cases.input_notes: apoB -15% / -12 mg/dL is from Ference 2017 (verified_primary=false).
Lipid changes from phase 2 dal-VESSEL (phase 3 paper reports only 'minimal effect' on LDL).
Niacin target (HCAR2) genetics not established -> uncertain. One-sided 0.025 = two-sided 0.05.
LDL abs = study-average difference; pct values are weeks 12-24.
sPLA2 change from phase 2 (phase 3 value not found). LDL baseline not given.
Lp(a) baseline not given -> Lp(a) term skipped (no default baseline for Lp(a)).
LDL at month 12 (ITT): -48.4 mg/dL.
LDL = time-averaged difference over the trial (-22 mg/dL).
150 mg arm vs placebo.
FRESH. -80% is the design-paper projection (not measured). Follow-up unknown (>=2.5 y): 3.0 assumed. Events = planned. Outcome numbers not disclosed.
Sensitivity variant: -72% (press figure / phase 2 60 mg arm).
Baseline 260.3 nmol/L converted with 2.4 nmol/L per mg/dL (assumption; no fixed conversion exists). Planned events not public.
Baseline 253.9 nmol/L converted with 2.4 nmol/L per mg/dL (assumption). Planned events not public.

LDL-C at 14 weeks (placebo-adjusted -56.8%; absolute -73.8 mg/dL = -1.908 mmol/L from registry LS mean difference). Attenuated to -43.2% at 52 weeks (antidrug antibodies), so the time-averaged effect is smaller. Median follow-up 12 months (trial stopped early by sponsor). Events = 179 + 224 primary events. Lp(a) baseline 19.1 mg/dL median not used (Lp(a) term skipped as in fourier).

LDL-C/apoB increased (positive = rise). LDL-C abs +0.26 mmol/L and apoB abs +5 mg/dL from Doi 2024 (verified_primary=false). non-HDL-C abs -0.007 mmol/L derived from -0.2% x baseline 128 mg/dL. TG absolute change not reported. Events = 572+560 primary events at futility stop (~75% of 1304 planned at interim). PPARA target genetics not established -> uncertain.

LDL-C abs -0.85 mmol/L = ITT average at study midpoint (S1, ~2/3 compliance); pct -30 from Merck topline S2 (FDA-label release says 32%). Events = 526 + 619 major atherosclerotic events (key outcome). alpha 0.01 = value used in the design power calculation (on the original major-vascular-events outcome); final threshold not found. Rate ratio (log-rank) used as observed_hr. No apoB/non-HDL-C/Lp(a) changes reported.

Placebo-adjusted 12-month changes from JAMA Table 4 geometric mean ratios (TG 0.82, non-HDL 0.95, apoB 0.99 NS, LDL-C 1.03, HDL-C 1.01). Absolute changes DERIVED as (GMR-1) x baseline median (TG 240 mg/dL, non-HDL 125 mg/dL, apoB 56 mg/dL, LDL-C 75 mg/dL). LDL-C (+3%) and apoB (-1%) are discordant, so the calculator should use non-HDL-C. Omega-3 has no single genetic target -> uncertain (LPL genetics support TG lowering only through apoB). Median follow-up 42.0 months. Events = 785 + 795 adjudicated (trial stopped for futility at 1384 interim events).

LDL-C: 12-month placebo-adjusted difference of medians -50%, mean difference -47 mg/dL = -1.2 mmol/L (S1). hsCRP -37% placebo-adjusted difference of medians (S1); CRP not causal by MR. apoB (-37.6%) and non-HDL-C (-40.3%, -54 mg/dL) omitted: within-arm only, not placebo-adjusted (S9). Trial stopped early for benefit at first interim analysis (393 of 520 planned events). Events = 142 + 251.

TG abs in mmol/L (-44.5 mg/dL, Hodges-Lehmann, NEJM). LDL-C and TG at 1 year (NEJM); the LDL-C difference is mostly a +10% rise in the mineral-oil placebo arm. non-HDL-C -0.41 mmol/L from Marston 2019 (consistent with FDA within-arm medians). apoB at 2 years is a DERIVED difference of within-arm medians (FDA Table 24: -2.5% vs +7.8%; -2 vs +6 mg/dL). hsCRP -0.65 mg/L (~50%) between-arm difference per FDA briefing. LDL/apoB percent ratio 0.64 -> calculator treats as discordant and uses non-HDL-C. Target genetics uncertain: no molecular target (ChEMBL mechanism unknown); TG-pathway genetics (LPL, APOC3) causal via apoB. Alpha: overall two-sided 0.05 (1-sided 0.025); final-look alpha 0.0437 after two interims. Events = 705 + 901 primary events.

Fenofibrate added to simvastatin vs simvastatin alone. Changes are DERIVED between-arm differences in within-arm change at end of study (NEJM S1): LDL-C +2.2 mg/dL (+0.057 mmol/L, n.s.), HDL-C +0.9 mg/dL (+0.023 mmol/L), TG -15.6 points from medians (-26 mg/dL). Placebo-adjusted non-HDL-C and apoB NOT FOUND, so the lipid effect is sized from LDL-C only. Intended biomarker = triglycerides (hypothesis: lower TG and raise HDL-C); PPARA genetics uncertain. Follow-up is a mean.

Active comparator: changes are atorvastatin 80 mg minus simvastatin 20-40 mg at 1 year (JAMA Table 2), not placebo-adjusted. LDL-C abs -22.9 mg/dL = -0.59 mmol/L (CTT 2010 gives -0.55). % changes derived as difference in % change from baseline. non-HDL-C fully derived (TC -28.7 minus HDL-C -1.3 = -27.4 mg/dL = -0.71 mmol/L). apoB -0.23 g/L = -23 mg/dL. Lp(a) not reported. Events = 463 + 411 primary major coronary events; follow-up = median 4.8 years.

Active comparator: changes are the 80 mg minus 10 mg atorvastatin between-arm difference, not placebo. abs_change -0.62 mmol/L is the CTT 2010 Table 1 LDL-C difference at 1 year for TNT (S6); pct_change -23.8 is derived from the reported arm means 77 vs 101 mg/dL (S1). Events = 434 + 548 first primary events. Alpha = adjusted final threshold 0.049 (nominal 0.05, two interim analyses). Follow-up = median 4.9 years. No apoB, non-HDL-C or Lp(a) data reported.

LDL-C placebo-adjusted at 3 months, derived from S1 per-arm values (-42.9% vs -1.9%; -1.1 vs -0.05 mmol/L); lipid levels converged later in the trial (time-averaged difference not reported). Events = 396 + 408 primary events (CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke). Follow-up = median 3.8 years (mean 3.2). alpha 0.05 two-sided from the revised power calculation (design paper: 4.86% two-sided after interim). No apoB/non-HDL-C/Lp(a) changes reported. Note: most primary events were CV deaths, largely non-atherosclerotic in hemodialysis, so the LDL-based calculator is expected to overpredict benefit.

Rosuvastatin 10 mg vs placebo comparison of the HOPE-3 2x2 factorial trial (S1). LDL-C: overall mean placebo-adjusted difference -34.6 mg/dL = -0.90 mmol/L, -26.5% (S1 Results and Fig. 1); the 1-year difference was -1.02 mmol/L (CTT convention; no 1-year % reported), 3-year -0.90, end of trial -0.76. apoB: overall mean difference -0.23 g/L = -23 mg/dL, -22.0% (Fig. 1 legend). Lipids measured in a 10-20% subsample. Events = 235 + 304 first coprimary events (CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke). Alpha = 0.04 allocated to the first coprimary outcome (0.02 to the second; overall 0.05 across both coprimaries and both factorial comparisons). Follow-up = median 5.6 years. Triglycerides -21.2 mg/dL and log hsCRP -0.19 omitted (no % change). Non-HDL-C, HDL-C and Lp(a) changes not reported.

Comparator is open-label usual care, not placebo: changes are pravastatin minus usual care, diluted by usual-care statin use (17% by year 4, 26% by year 6) and pravastatin non-adherence. abs_change -0.54 mmol/L is the CTT 2010 Table 1 LDL-C difference at 1 year for ALLHAT-LLT (S6); pct_change -16.7 is the paper's year-4 LDL-C differential (27.7% vs 11.0% reduction; Friedewald, random subsample) (S1). Primary endpoint all-cause mortality: events = 631 + 641 deaths; observed_hr is the reported RR 0.99 (0.89-1.11). Secondary CHD events RR 0.91 (0.79-1.04), 380 + 421 events. Follow-up = mean 4.8 years. No apoB, non-HDL-C or Lp(a) data reported.

LDL-C placebo-adjusted at 3 months: -45.0% reported as the between-group difference (S1); abs -1.63 mmol/L derived from per-arm values (rosuvastatin 3.54 -> 1.96, placebo 3.52 -> 3.57 mmol/L). Events = 692 + 732 primary events (CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke; planned 1422). Follow-up = median 32.8 months. alpha 0.05 two-sided. No apoB/non-HDL-C/Lp(a) changes reported in CORONA (phase 2 label values not used). Note: most primary events were cardiovascular deaths, mostly sudden, in failing myocardium, so the LDL-based calculator is expected to overpredict benefit.

Primary endpoint used: all-cause death (co-primary 1). LDL-C abs_change -0.92 mmol/L is the CTT 2010 Table 1 LDL-C difference at 1 year for GISSI-HF (S5); pct_change -30.1 derived as -0.92/3.06 (CTT baseline). At 3 years the derived placebo-adjusted difference was smaller (-0.78 mmol/L, -24.7%, S6). Events = 657 + 644 deaths. Follow-up = median 3.9 years. alpha 0.045 two-sided derived from the 95.5% CI reported for death (the combined death/CV-hospitalisation endpoint used 99% CI: HR 1.01, 0.908-1.112, 1305 + 1283 events). observed_hr is the adjusted HR. No apoB, non-HDL-C or Lp(a) changes reported. Note: most deaths in heart failure are non-occlusive (pump failure, arrhythmia), so an LDL-based calculator is expected to overpredict benefit on all-cause death.

Active comparator: changes are atorvastatin 80 mg minus pravastatin 40 mg, not placebo. abs_change -0.65 mmol/L is the CTT 2010 Table 1 mean LDL-C difference at 1 year for PROVE-IT (S5); the NEJM paper gives a 33 mg/dL (0.85 mmol/L) difference of medians during follow-up (62 vs 95 mg/dL). pct_change -31.1 is derived as (62-95)/106, the difference in % change from the common baseline median of 106 mg/dL (S1). HR 0.84 (0.74-0.95) derived from the reported 16% hazard reduction (95% CI 5 to 26%). Events = 464 + 537 first primary events (BMS release S2; Murphy 2009 S7). Follow-up = mean 24 months (CTT median 2.1 years). Alpha = two-sided 0.05 for the superiority test (trial designed for noninferiority of pravastatin, margin RR 1.17). No apoB, non-HDL-C or Lp(a) on-treatment differences reported.

Placebo-adjusted LDL-C derived from mean on-treatment levels 72.9 vs 128.5 mg/dL (1.89 vs 3.32 mmol/L; S1); authors round the difference to 1.4 mmol/L. Intention-to-treat contrast diluted by open-label statin use in the placebo arm. non-HDL-C derived (TC minus HDL-C), not reported by the trial. Events = 265 + 311 first fatal or nonfatal strokes (any type, including hemorrhagic). Alpha = final threshold 0.048 after seven interim analyses. Observed HR is the prespecified adjusted estimate (unadjusted P=0.05). Primary end point is stroke, not major vascular events; no apoB, SBP or Lp(a) on-treatment data.

Primary 3-point MACE (CHD death, MI, ischemic stroke): events = 336 + 443 (planned 751). LDL-C = placebo-adjusted 48-week lipid-substudy change (-55%, -63 mg/dL; mmol/L DERIVED as 63/38.67), read in secondary sources only. Alpha 0.025 two-sided per primary endpoint as used for sample size in the SAP (overall 0.05 via truncated Hochberg). Lp(a) % change not reported -> Lp(a) term skipped. Second primary 4-point MACE: 747 + 907 events, HR 0.81 (0.73-0.89).

Omega-3 vs placebo comparison of the 2x2 factorial VITAL trial only (1 g/day Omacor, 840 mg EPA+DHA). VITAL did not report a placebo-adjusted triglyceride, LDL-C, apoB or non-HDL-C change (NOT FOUND). The TG change is an EXTERNAL expected effect: 5.9 mg/dL lower TG per 1 g/day omega-3 from a dose-response analysis of 58 placebo-controlled trials (Mozaffarian & Wu 2011, cited by Hu, Hu & Manson 2019) = -0.067 mmol/L (DERIVED /88.57); pct -5.3% DERIVED from VITAL baseline median TG 111 mg/dL. No apoB or non-HDL-C value exists, so the lipid pathway is barely quantifiable and the calculator may abstain. Measured exposure: plasma omega-3 index +54.7% at 1 year (active arm, n=1,583). Omega-3 has no single genetic target -> uncertain (LPL/APOC3 genetics support TG lowering only through apoB). Median follow-up 5.3 years. Events = 386 + 419 major cardiovascular events (MI, stroke, CV death). Design: 89% power for an observed RR 0.80, two-sided alpha 0.05.

OMEGA-3 ARM of the ASCEND 2x2 factorial only (1 g/day omega-3 ethyl esters, 840 mg EPA+DHA, vs olive-oil placebo; aspirin comparison excluded). Triglycerides were NOT measured in ASCEND (mailed samples), so no TG row; at the same dose ORIGIN found TG -14.5 mg/dL (-0.16 mmol/L) vs placebo (golden S8). Lipid changes are placebo-adjusted between-group differences at a mean 2.5 years in a random subset (about 471-620 per group), adjusted for baseline (NEJM Supplementary Table S7): non-HDL-C -2.4 mg/dL (95% CI -5.6 to 0.8) = -0.062 mmol/L (x0.02586), apoB -1.2 mg/dL (-3.2 to 0.8), HDL-C +1.3 mg/dL (0.4 to 2.2) = +0.034 mmol/L. Percent changes DERIVED as difference / subset placebo baseline (110, 80, 49 mg/dL). LDL-C not reported. Omega-3 Index rose 32.5% relative to placebo (exposure marker, not sized). Target genetics uncertain: no single molecular target; Mendelian randomization of circulating omega-3 is mixed (null in Borges 2022, EPA protective in Park 2021); TG-pathway genetics (LPL, APOC3) causal via apoB. Follow-up = mean 7.4 years (median not reported). Events = 689 + 712 serious vascular events. Alpha two-tailed 0.05. observed_hr is the log-rank rate ratio.

pct_change -40.9 is the trial-average placebo-adjusted LDL-C difference (S5); abs_change -1.14 mmol/L is the CTT 2010 Table 1 LDL-C difference at 1 year for CARDS (S8). apoB -24.3% placebo-adjusted (S5); absolute apoB change not reported. Events = 83 + 127 patients with a first primary event (S1). Trial stopped early for benefit at the second interim analysis with 210 of 304 planned events. Alpha = final primary-endpoint threshold 0.049 (S6); the interim stopping boundary was p<0.001. Follow-up = median 3.9 years. Intention-to-treat contrast diluted by 9% placebo statin drop-in and 15% atorvastatin discontinuation (S15). No non-HDL-C, Lp(a) or SBP on-treatment data.

OMEMI: 1.8 g/day mixed EPA+DHA (930 mg EPA + 660 mg DHA) vs corn oil in 1,014 ITT patients aged 70-82 after recent MI. Triglyceride change = between-group difference in median percent change at 24 months (-8.1% vs +5.1%; 'between-group median absolute difference 13.2%', accepted manuscript S4); abs_change DERIVED as -13.2% x baseline mean 1.26 mmol/L = -0.166 mmol/L. LDL-C change DERIVED from medians 0% vs +0.7% (p=0.57) x baseline 1.95 mmol/L = -0.014 mmol/L. apoB, non-HDL-C and Lp(a) changes NOT reported, so the calculator must size via TG (or abstain). Patients were not selected for high TG (mean 111.4 mg/dL). Omega-3 has no single genetic target -> uncertain (LPL/APOC3 genetics support TG lowering only through apoB; MR on omega-3 levels mixed). followup_years = scheduled fixed 2-year follow-up (median not reported; DERIVED mean event-free follow-up about 1.7 years). Events = 108 + 102 primary composite events (non-fatal MI, unscheduled revascularization, stroke, all-cause death, HF hospitalization; HF added mid-trial). observed_hr/CI from the Circulation version-of-record abstract (S1); the accepted manuscript gives 1.07 (0.82-1.40), p=0.62. Two-tailed alpha 0.05. Sized for a 25% reduction (80% power) assuming a 35% two-year event rate; observed about 20%.

Final primary end point (MACE or hospitalization for unstable angina leading to urgent revascularization): events = 201 + 207 (revised plan 634; original MACE plan 530; original MACE observed 170 + 167, HR 1.01 (0.82-1.25)). Biomarker changes at 8 months, DERIVED as LD-MTX minus placebo median change (Table S2): hsCRP +0.04 mg/L (+2.7 points, P=0.83, i.e. no reduction), LDL-C -2.4 mg/dL = -0.062 mmol/L (-3.5 points). IL-6 rose (+0.26 pg/mL, P=0.001) and IL-1beta unchanged (P=0.62) - not fed to the calculator. Target DHFR: no genetic instrument -> 'uncertain'; the drug did not engage the genetically supported IL-6 pathway. No pathway key: methotrexate does not act on IL-1beta or IL-6. Alpha 0.05 two-sided from the design paper.
